T: Thirteen hours to solve it. Plenty of time for dessert.
D: A teenager has thirteen hours to solve a goblin king's labyrinth and rescue her baby brother.
P: Serve dessert when Sarah bites the peach.
S: the little worm invites Sarah in to meet the missus
Fingers of buttered fruit loaf toasted, served with a pot of English breakfast tea, the way you'd host a guest in a tiny burrow.
Bog of Eternal Stench garlic dip
the bog, but this one smells good
Whole heads of garlic roasted at 180C for 45 minutes, squeezed and whipped into cream cheese and sour cream with lemon, with crusty bread.
M: Masked ball lemon and thyme roast chicken
the masked ball in the bubble

Whole chicken rubbed with thyme butter and roasted over lemon, with crisp duck fat potatoes and a rich pan gravy. Mash 80g soft butter with thyme leaves, garlic and salt and push under the skin of a 1.8kg chicken. Put a halved lemon in the cavity. Roast at 220C for 20 minutes, then 180C for 50 minutes until the juices run clear, and rest 15 minutes. Parboil 1kg potatoes for 8 minutes, rough them up and roast in 3 tbsp duck fat at 220C for 50 minutes. Stir 1 tbsp flour into the tray juices, add 350ml chicken stock and simmer 5 minutes for gravy.
Hoggle the dwarf and his little garden

Beef chuck braised slowly with onion, carrot, mushroom, thyme and tomato in a rich stock, served over buttery mash with chopped parsley. Brown 1kg diced beef chuck in batches in 2 tbsp oil. Soften 1 diced onion, 2 carrots and 250g mushrooms in the same pot. Stir in 2 tbsp tomato paste, 1 tbsp Worcestershire, thyme and 750ml beef stock. Cover and braise at 160C for 3 hours until tender. Mash 1kg potatoes with 60g butter and 100ml milk. Serve the stew over the mash with chopped parsley.
W: the peach that sends Sarah to the masked ball

Peaches poached in vanilla, honey and apple syrup, skins slipped off and chilled, served with sweet mascarpone and a crumble of almond biscuits. Simmer 400ml apple juice, 200ml water, 100g caster sugar, 2 tbsp honey and a split vanilla bean for 5 minutes. Add 4 halved peaches and poach gently for 10 minutes, then slip off the skins and chill in the syrup for at least 2 hours. Beat 250g mascarpone with 1 tbsp icing sugar. Serve two halves each with a spoon of mascarpone, a little syrup and crumbled almond biscuits.
K: Goblin King's spiced apple and pear punch

Cloudy apple and pear juice warmed with cinnamon, star anise and orange peel, served hot in mugs or poured over ice with sparkling water. Pour 1L cloudy apple juice and 500ml pear juice into a pot with 2 cinnamon sticks, 3 star anise and 2 strips of orange peel. Simmer gently for 10 minutes so the spices come through, then strain. Serve warm in mugs with a cinnamon stick, or cool it and pour over ice, topping each glass with 50ml sparkling water.

s.note: the little worm invites Sarah in to meet the missus
s.how: Toast 8 thick slices of fruit loaf until the edges crisp, butter generously and cut into fingers. Warm a teapot, add 4 tea bags and 1L boiling water and brew 4 minutes. Serve with milk on the side, like a guest in a burrow.

s.n: Bog of Eternal Stench garlic dip
s.note: the bog, but this one smells good
s.how: Wrap 2 whole garlic heads in foil and roast at 180C for 45 minutes. Squeeze out the soft cloves and beat with 250g cream cheese, 100g sour cream, lemon juice and salt until smooth. Serve with torn baguette for dipping.
